selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

selection.summary: Reviewed base evidence for adding DOM pretty printing (issue #1329) with indentation fixed to four spaces. The existing serialization machinery is the key target: include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h already declares the templated string_builder<formatter> explicitly designed to support both minification and prettification via a pluggable formatter (mini_formatter default), with append/clear/str entry points for elements, arrays, objects, and key_value_pairs. The mini_formatter API (comma, start_array, end_array, start_object, end_object, atoms, number, key, string, clear, str) and its inline implementation in serialization-inl.h (including parser::print_json, fast_itoa helpers, buffer/str handling) are the base on which a prettifier formatter (e.g., adding indentation/newlines via an overridden formatter or new methods) would be built. Handles cover the full declaration and implementation ranges of both files; no recovery tools available, so no patched files were verified—only base evidence was assessed.
